sentences.text: Setiap hari pangsit goreng buatan Fajar habis sebelum sore.
sentences.en: Every day Fajar's fried wontons sell out before evening.
sentences.ko: 파자르가 만든 튀김 만두는 매일 저녁 전에 다 팔려요.

sentences.text: Lestari membuat pangsit isi sayur dari kebun sendiri.
sentences.en: Lestari makes wontons filled with vegetables from her own garden.
sentences.ko: 레스타리는 직접 키운 채소로 속을 채운 만두를 빚어요.
